text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, autumn is the season for the 
arts, isn't it?

At the hot spring inn we visited for a 
rest, Wonder Acute suddenly said that.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, they're holding an autumn 
painting contest in the hot springs town~

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Believe it or not, drawing is one of my 
little talents. I think I'll participate~

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking for some scenery to use as a 
motif... Would you care to join me for a 
little stroll?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
When you think of a hot springs town, you 
think of this kind of view... Let's see 
here. Hmm, hmm...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Mumuu!?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it's nice and lively, but... For the 
atmosphere I want to draw, maybe the 
background is a bit too overpowering?
choice_data_list:
That really does sound like something an 
artist would say...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. I truly am someone who draws, you 
know~? Now then, let us move on to the 
next one.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I can really feel the wabi-sabi here... 
Though maybe it's a bit too subdued this 
time around.
choice_data_list: I see you're particular about the scenery.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
No, it's actually getting pretty close 
though...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's true. But the atmosphere I want to 
paint is already decided, you know?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
So, no rush, just take it easy. All we 
gotta do is look~... *slurp*.

And so, following behind Wonder Acute, we 
spent a few hours wandering around in 
search of material—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh, where is this...?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
The mountains are so pretty with all the 
red, green, and yellow. It feels so 
warm...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Muhoh!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, it's here~! Excuse me for a 
moment... Oh my, yes, hooh...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's perfect, let's do it here! All 
righty, time to start drawing~!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Tooooooooh!

Cautious, yet bold. Trusting her 
instincts, Wonder Acute lets her brush 
glide across.
choice_data_list:
(I wonder what kind of picture it'll turn 
out to be.)

text_block_list.text:
Looking forward to that with anticipation, 
as occasional splatters of paint hit my 
face—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's finished~. Even if I say so myself, 
it's a masterpiece~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes, here you go. It turned out well, 
don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
The mountains covered in autumn leaves, 
and— Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. It fits your vibe perfectly, 
Trainer. I'm so glad I found this 
background."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
She's so warm and fuzzy, so expressive, 
and so comforting.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Emotional Support"... That's so perfect 
for this competition's theme.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's right. The moment I saw it, it just 
clicked. I knew I had no choice but to 
participate.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...I've always thought about this, you 
know. Running can really be painful 
sometimes. Truly.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But you know... when you have someone by 
your side, it's surprisingly easy to keep 
going.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
By looking at the same thing together, we 
were able to reaffirm what's truly 
important, weren't we?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"To be able to talk about ordinary things 
at ordinary times..."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...See? Doing that is what let me keep 
going.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's tough, you know. Walking through this 
long life all on your own.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Still, what if you were to meet someone 
you could just casually have tea with out 
of the blue?"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Drinking tea together, chatting about 
nothing in particular... What if I could 
meet someone I could laugh with forever?"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"...Was the kind of feeling I poured into 
it~ I wonder, I hope it came across 
properly."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...Ufufu. I'm glad to hear that then~.

As a wave of happiness washed over me... a 
certain thought crossed my mind.
choice_data_list: Maybe I should enter the contest, too.

Maybe I'll try entering a competition, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My, how lovely...! I wonder what kind of 
picture you'll draw, Trainer?
choice_data_list: …Would you mind if I used you as a model?
...Can I use you as a model?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my goodness...! Fufu, just having you 
choose something for me makes me happy.
And so, a few days later—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
They put your painting in a nice spot, 
didn't they? Must've had a good model, 
huh?
choice_data_list:
It feels a little embarrassing when I 
realize it's about me, though...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: What are you even saying...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's the absolute best expression, if 
you ask me. Stand tall and be proud of it.
And so, a few days later—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, the drawing I made turned into a 
"T-shirt"~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I won the “Master Painter Award,” you see~ 
So I'm feeling a little proud of myself.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'll give this to you for now, Trainer. 
Hehe, it's sure to suit you the best.
